a new algorithm, McTwo (Maximal Information Coefficient based two-step feature selection), was developed for feature selection from high-dimensional datasets; the McTwo algorithm was compared to 17 existing algorithms on 17 datasets; McTwo performed as well as or even better than the existing algorithms; McTwo selected a smaller feature subset than other algorithms; the features selected by McTwowere associated with the phenotypes in a biological manner.
